instruction: Candid wedding photograph, full-length shot. In an outdoor paved courtyard, the groom in a beige suit (R2) and the bride in a white wedding dress (R1) stand back-to-back. The groom on the left faces left, while the smiling bride on the right faces right. They hold hands behind their backs. Soft natural daylight illuminates the scene, casting gentle shadows on the stone pavement.
